{{Quote|We came here because they promised us jobs, and a good life, and we celebrated our good fortune, for our world is poor. But they worked us like slaves and would not let us leave.|A Duroon rebel|<ref name="HSSE" />}}
The '''Duroon Rebels''' were a group of offworld contract-slaves working in a forced-labor camp on the planet [[Duroon]]. They started a rebellion against their [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] oppressors when they were not given the rewards they were promised. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] delivered a shipment of outdated, contraband weapons to them during the [[Mission to Duroon]].
